prompt: Create a contact form with full name, email address, and message fields. All fields should be required.
Create a customer feedback survey with a 1-5 rating dropdown, a checkbox group for topics (Product, Support, Billing), and optional comments.
Create an event RSVP form with guest name, email, number of attendees, and dietary restrictions as long text.
Create a newsletter signup with email and a checkbox to agree to terms.
Create a support ticket form with subject, priority dropdown (Low, Medium, High, Critical), description, and file upload for screenshots.

Create an employee onboarding form with full name, start date as short text, department dropdown (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Other), and a conditional other department text field when Other is selected.
Create a PTO request form with employee name, start date, end date, PTO type dropdown (Vacation, Sick, Personal), and reason as long text.
Create a new hire equipment request with name, laptop preference radio (Mac, Windows), and optional monitor checkbox.
Create an exit interview form with employee name, department dropdown, reason for leaving as long text, and would you recommend us radio (Yes, No).
Create an employee referral form with referrer name, candidate name, candidate email, and relationship dropdown.
Create a benefits enrollment form. Ask if enrolling in health insurance (Yes/No radio). If Yes, show dropdown for plan tier (Basic, Plus, Premium). If No, show a long text reason field.
Create a vendor onboarding form. Ask business type (Individual, Company). If Company, show company name and tax ID fields. If Individual, show full legal name only.
Create an order form with same as billing checkbox. When unchecked, show shipping address, city, and zip as short text fields.
Create a registration form with date of birth as short text and a checkbox confirming age 18+. If checkbox unchecked, disable the submit-related email field.
Create a job application with role dropdown (Engineer, Designer). If Engineer, show years of experience number field. If Designer, show portfolio URL as short text.
Create a document submission form with applicant name, document type dropdown (Resume, ID, Certificate), and file upload. All required.
Create an invoice submission form with vendor name, invoice number, amount as number, and PDF upload.
Create a compliance form with employee name, attestation checkbox, and supporting document upload.
Create a branded contact form with theme color #0061D5. Fields: name, email, message. All required.
Create an event registration form with Box blue theme #0061D5, attendee name, email, and session dropdown (AM, PM).
Make a form for customers.
Create a form titled exactly 'General Inquiry' with name and email fields. Ensure the title is unique for Box.
Create a detailed intake form with 8 fields: first name, last name, email, phone, company, job title, country dropdown, and notes.
Create a form with no fields but a title only called Empty Form Test.
Create a form with one email field that shows and hides itself when filled.
Create a contact form with full name, email address, and message fields. All fields should be required.
